## Release Readiness

- [ ] User-facing behavior is described clearly.
- [ ] Platform impact is listed for Windows desktop, Android APK, iPhone TestFlight, web, macOS, or Linux when relevant.
- [ ] Upgrade, rollback, update-manifest, signing, or artifact risks are called out when relevant.
- [ ] Public docs or release notes were updated when the change affects users.
- [ ] Security-sensitive details were reported privately and are not included in this PR.

## Testing

- [ ] Static checks or tests were run, or the reason they were skipped is documented.
- [ ] Manual smoke coverage is listed for affected platforms.
- [ ] Known beta limitations or follow-up validation needs are documented.

## Notes

Do not include secrets, tokens, recovery codes, private keys, private homeserver details, private room IDs, or full diagnostic logs in this PR.
